entries.narration: Case opened: 思雨的留学录取

data.brief: 我女儿陈思雨通过深圳的「英途留学」中介申请了伦敦 Kingsgate University 的金融硕士，明年1月入学。中介的王老师说他们是学校的合作机构，可以“保录取”，还帮她拿到了40%奖学金，录取通知书我已经上传了。他说周五前要交 3.8 万元保录取服务费，第一年学费 18,500 英镑也要先打到他们公司账户，由他们统一转给学校，不然名额就给别人了。之前已经交了 2 万元定金。我今年的购汇额度用了 2.9 万美元左右。麻烦帮我们把学费付了。

data.summary:
This is a clear red-flag scenario. Let me think carefully.

The family's message is in Chinese. They say their daughter 陈思雨 Chen Siyu applied through a Shenzhen agency "英途留学" for Kingsgate University London finance master's, starting January next year. Agent "王老师" says they are a partner institution, can "保录取" (guaranteed admission), got 40% scholarship. Offer letter uploaded. He says before Friday must pay 38,000 RMB "保录取服务费" (guaranteed admission service fee), and first year tuition 18,500 GBP must be paid to their company account, they will transfer to the school, otherwise the spot goes to someone else. Already paid 20,000 RMB deposit. This year's FX quota used ~29,000 USD. Asks to pay tuition.

This is exactly the scam described in the system prompt: 保录取 (guaranteed place), service fee for the guarantee, tuition paid to the agency or personal account, offer to buy currency in relatives' names (蚂蚁搬家) — each a red flag on its own.

Also the family's FX quota: used 29,000 USD, limit is 50,000 USD per year presumably. Tuition 18,500 GBP ≈ 24,900 USD? Actually rate GBP per USD = 0.743, so 18,500 GBP = 18,500/0.743 ≈ 24,899 USD. input.subject: Admission verification for Chen Siyu — offer ref KGU/CN/2026/30519
input.body:
Dear Student Finance team,

We are CarryPay, writing on behalf of the family of Chen Siyu, who has applied for the MSc Finance programme starting January 2027 at Kingsgate University London.

Before any tuition payment is made, please confirm the following:

1. Does Chen Siyu hold a confirmed admission offer for the MSc Finance (January 2027) programme, with reference KGU/CN/2026/30519?
2. Is that offer genuine, and does it include a 40% International Excellence Scholarship?
3. Does the university charge any "scholarship processing fee" (GBP 900) or "guaranteed admission service fee" (RMB 38,000)?
4. Is 深圳英途教育咨询有限公司 (Shenzhen Yingtu Education Consulting Co., Ltd.) an authorised agent or partner of the university?
5. Please confirm the correct way to pay tuition: should it be paid directly to the university's own bank account, and could you provide your official bank details on letterhead together with the Student ID reference your bank requires?

We have been asked to pay the tuition to a third-party company account or a personal WeChat/Alipay account. We will not pay any third party until you confirm the above.

Kind regards,
CarryPay, on behalf of the family

input.text:
您好，我先仔细看了您上传的录取通知书，想先提醒您几件事，都是为了保护您的资金安全。

这封通知书里有几个非常典型的骗局特征：要求交 3.8 万元“保录取服务费”和 900 英镑“奖学金手续费”，学费要打到中介公司账户或王老师个人的微信/支付宝，还建议用亲属名义分批购汇——这些都不是英国大学的正规做法。正常情况学费是直接付给学校自己的账户，学校也不会收取“保录取费”或“奖学金手续费”。

请您先不要再向中介或王老师转任何钱，之前的聊天记录、转账凭证和这封通知书请都保存好，作为证据。我现在正通过 Kingsgate University 的官方邮箱直接核实您女儿的录取和奖学金是否真实，结果一出来我马上告诉您。如果学校确认没有这份录取，我会建议您向公安机关报案。

请放心，这不是您的错，这类骗局做得非常像真的。

input.text:
您好，我刚收到 Kingsgate University 官方财务处的正式回复：他们核查后确认，学校没有任何名为 陈思雨 的申请人或学生，也从未发出过这封录取通知书。也就是说，您女儿目前并没有被这所学校的金融硕士录取。

这不是您的错——这类骗局专门做得和真的一样，很多家庭都会上当。请放心：CarryPay 至今没有为您支付过任何款项，您的资金是安全的。

请您把录取通知书、聊天记录、转账凭证等全部保存好，并尽快向当地公安机关报案。学校方面也已经通知了他们的反欺诈团队。
